\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}

8-22. Let $A$ be any algebra over $\mathbb {R}$ . A derivation of $A$ is a linear map $D : A \rightarrow A$ satisfying $D\left( {xy}\right) = \left( {Dx}\right) y + x\left( {Dy}\right)$ for all $x, y \in A$ . Show that if ${D}_{1}$ and ${D}_{2}$ are derivations of $A$ , then $\left\lbrack {{D}_{1},{D}_{2}}\right\rbrack = {D}_{1} \circ {D}_{2} - {D}_{2} \circ {D}_{1}$ is also a derivation. Show that the set of derivations of $A$ is a Lie algebra with this bracket operation. \end{exercise}
